code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 9)
    bg = 9
    color = 2

        for c in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c-1] == marker and row[c+1] == marker:
